title: Rebalancing Your Portfolio Once a Year Keeps Your Risk in Check
summary: Leave a portfolio alone and rising stocks will quietly raise its risk. Pick one date a year to compare your mix with its target, and rebalance whenever an asset class has drifted 5 percentage points or more. Rebalancing won’t raise your return, but it keeps your risk where you set it. Source
